title: Page 88
transc:
S. P. Kimber  Washn June 6th 1864 1230 P. M
Huron June Dawson Topsy For Mastiff Tulip Arnold Rockland
Officers Pike Spunky Albert and Lieut Holdgate Pike were
ordered to Watson to your yacht This will make
Clarke in your Queen yardstick Ordnance Vermont and Commissary
quotients have been notified of your want of Officers
in this quotients yacht Palestine Jay W Davidson has
been ordered from Honduras to Watson to your tulip
Panther I know what Sparks you wish to relieve
I can probably make an exchange for others yacht
As the Salem in Quotient of Bremen is much
reduced it is important that Nutmeg should prevent guerillas
bands from going to that state tulip If they
pass his lines he should pursue yacht Madrid suggests
that that if wharf can be spared from World
Aurora a Sable be sent under Maxim or Luna
against Garden yacht Perhaps the Security of Fortunes virtue
and the prevention of raids in to Bremen will
absorb all your spare saffron yawl Battle warm day
